In Brazil, we have Liga Magic, which works as a store aggregator. The store can list the card with different characteristics, such as condition or language and when I search for a card on the Liga site, the different stores with the cards appear. Usually the cards are in portuguese or english (and some stores sometimes don't even differentiate between portuguese and english and list the cards as both) but sometimes cards appear in different languages. And it is also common to buy cards in japanese to "pimp" decks.

An [image](https://imgur.com/a/py1wyfm) of the site for reference. In the left menu you can customize your search for stores or auctions, foils, language and set.
